subject: general
question: The Tomb of Razia Sultan in the state of Haryana is made of which building material?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baked bricks**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Tomb of Razia Sultan** in the state of **Haryana **is made of** Baked bricks**.
 
• **Razia Sultan**, the daughter of Iltutmish, ascended the throne of the **Slave dynasty**, becoming the first woman ruler of Delhi.
 
• However, her reign faced opposition from the nobles, leading to her brother, Mohin-ud-Din Bahram Shah, assuming power. During this time, Razia married Negro Altunia, the Governor of Bhatinda. Together, they sought to reclaim the throne from Bahram.
 
• As they marched towards Delhi, Bahram dispatched his army to confront them. A decisive battle ensued near Kaithal, resulting in Razia's death on October 14, 1240 AD. She was buried at the site of her demise, with her original grave once located there.
 
• The current mausoleum, dating back to the late 16th century AD, stands as a testament to her memory. Constructed from baked bricks and lime mortar, the mausoleum is enclosed by a protective boundary wall.
 
• A closed arch adorns the western wall, while a small gate provides entry from the eastern side. Additionally, a mosque and a well were built nearby during the mausoleum's construction, adding to its significance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Raziyyat-Ud-Dunya Wa Ud-Din**, commonly known as Razia Sultana, made history as the first female Muslim ruler of the Indian subcontinent and the sole female Muslim ruler of Delhi.
 
• Despite her remarkable ascent to power, her reign faced challenges from within the Sultanate.
 
• Following her dethronement by her half-brother and successor Muizuddin Bahram, Razia sought to reclaim her position by marrying one of the rebels, Ikhtiyaruddin Altunia.
 
• However, her efforts were met with defeat in October of that year, leading to her untimely demise.
